items.title: Struggling Diageo to cut costs by more than a billion
items.summary: Beverage manufacturer Diageo, owner of Johnnie Walker, Smirnoff, and Baileys, plans to make significant cost cuts following a decline in revenue, while simultaneously investing in growth for brands such as Guinness and premixed cocktails.

items.title: H&M plans round of layoffs in the UK
items.summary: H&M has informed approximately 250 British office employees of an impending reorganization that could result in job losses. The restructuring follows earlier measures in the Netherlands, Belgium, and Spain, which have already resulted in the loss of hundreds of jobs.

items.title: Diageo CEO seeks to “right-size business”

items.title: Ralph Lauren reports higher-than-expected growth in turnover and profit
items.summary: Ralph Lauren closed the first quarter of its fiscal year with net revenue of $1.96 billion (approximately 1.7 billion euros), up 14% from a year earlier. Following this better-than-expected start, the company is also raising its outlook for the full fiscal year.
